# Upbit public fixtures

- `ticker.default.json` and `trade.default.json` are copied from the official DEFAULT-format
  examples retrieved through `docs/upbit_document_snapshot.json` on 2026-08-23.
- `orderbook.synthetic.json` is a deliberately small synthetic message using the official field
  contract. It is not evidence of live market state.

Fixtures contain public market data only and no credentials or account identifiers.
